_meta.method: Each row has two columns that are never merged. 'Brief says' is copied from the brief. 'This repo shows' is what was measured or read in this checkout (branch arena/38650305-zone3). Rows marked 'Not found' have no matching text or file here, whatever the brief says. The brief's status labels cite the owner's Zone4 decision log (https://kanlerxz87-cyber.github.io/Zone4/docs/decisions.html); that log was reachable on 2026-11-17 but its individual S-rows were not re-read line by line, so 'Brief says' is not independently verified. A second same-day re-measurement by session cdb0a5ac (branch arena/cdb0a5ac-zone3) merged here: row texts carry both passes' facts, counts reflect the merged tree after the ninth guide shipped, and prior_2026_11_17 still holds the original 17 Nov text wherever a row changed.

status_vocabulary.Verified here: Measured or read in this checkout on the date shown.
status_vocabulary.Partly here: Some of the claimed work is present; the rest is missing or not measured.
status_vocabulary.Not found here: The brief claims it, but no matching page or file exists in this checkout.
status_vocabulary.Conflict: The repo does something the brief rules out.
status_vocabulary.Blocked (owner): Needs an account, a decision or a host that this build cannot reach.
status_vocabulary.Not measured: No measurement was made this session.
